sql: SELECT s.assistant_name, s.updated_at, position('Bia' in coalesce(s.extra_instructions,'')) AS bia_in_info, substring(s.extra_instructions from greatest(position('Bia' in s.extra_instructions) - 80, 1) for 200) AS around FROM ai_agent_settings s WHERE s.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
